verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference, fine-tuning and hosting platform. Its documented capabilities are developer building blocks that a user could call to build their own insight features: chat completions, structured outputs, function calling and agent loops. Nothing in the pack shows the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data (such as usage, logs or datasets) inside its console or UI, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
